currentWork.title: FINAL.63 live: unified Today vending+delivery card list with left-swipe delivery completion
currentWork.scope: Owner chose to remove separate 本日の納品 block and make all due/overdue/just-completed deliveries ordinary cards inside the SAME #todayList as vending sites, with 📦 marker, management code, items+quantity and free-form sale-price notes, shared status badge and same one-tap external Google Maps. Tap delivery card itself to open delivery-site details. Swipe LEFT on pending delivery to mark complete immediately without extra confirm; swipe RIGHT does nothing (must never delete/skip/cancel). Existing vending left-complete/right-skip stays unchanged. Completed-today delivery remains in normal list as done and counts once in Today total+completion; other date completed excluded. The separate 納品 tab retains editing, explicit-confirm complete, previous completed copy and immutable history. No schema/data migration, in-app HGV routing remains retired, temporary cycle override remains retired, and 1ヶ月に1回=28 days. Shared pointer handler reused for both work types, with delivery completion immediate; external-nav tap excluded from swipe tracking. Central Today renderer refreshes integrated deliveries reliably, and version.json synchronized to avoid background forced reload.
